skillCode: var p=context.rulePiece;if(!p||!context.sourcePiece||context.sourcePiece.instanceId!==p.instanceId||!(context.damage>0))return{success:false,message:''};battle.extensions=battle.extensions||{};battle.extensions.contentCounters=battle.extensions.contentCounters||{};var key=p.ownerPlayerId;var old=Number(battle.extensions.contentCounters[key]||0);var total=old+Number(context.damage||0);var discount=Math.floor(total/4);battle.extensions.contentCounters[key]=total%4;battle.extensions.contentCounters.elPrimoChargeDiscount=battle.extensions.contentCounters.elPrimoChargeDiscount||{};battle.extensions.contentCounters.elPrimoChargeDiscount[key]=Math.min(2,Number(battle.extensions.contentCounters.elPrimoChargeDiscount[key]||0)+discount);return{success:discount>0,message:discount>0?p.name+'受伤计数达到'+discount+'层':''};
